description: This file implements the main command for stopping a Cuttlefish virtual device, including clean shutdown procedures, fallback process termination, and command-line argument parsing.

classes.name: FlagVaules
classes.description: Holds command-line flag values for wait duration, directory cleanup, and help XML flag.

methods.name: FallbackDirs
methods.description: Returns a set of directories to attempt fallback process termination.

methods.name: DirsForInstance
methods.description: Returns a set of directories associated with a specific Cuttlefish instance.

methods.name: GetCandidateProcessGroups
methods.description: Retrieves process group IDs of processes associated with given directories.

methods.name: FallBackStop
methods.description: Kills process groups associated with given directories as a fallback shutdown method.

methods.name: CleanStopInstance
methods.description: Performs a clean shutdown of a Cuttlefish instance via launcher socket.

methods.name: StopInstance
methods.description: Attempts to stop an instance cleanly, falling back to process group kill if needed.

methods.name: ReleaseAllocdResources
methods.description: Sends a request to allocd to release resources for a session.

methods.name: GetFlagValues
methods.description: Parses command-line flags for wait time, directory cleanup, and help XML.

methods.name: StopCvdMain
methods.description: Main logic for stopping Cuttlefish, managing multiple instances and cleanup.
